compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: No reviewer agent definition file contains references to REVIEW_RESULT, MIN_SCORE, or a scores object in its output contract
- DD2: reviewer-base.md specifies exactly two top-level keys (findings, summary) in the JSON schema and a 3-line output format

## What to modify
tests/docs/test-reviewer-base-file-constraint.sh — add structural contract tests following the same design-contract pattern used in that file (prompt text IS the behavioral contract):

### test_no_review_result_in_output_contract
Given: plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md
When: grep for REVIEW_RESULT in the mandatory output contract section
Then: NOT present (the 3-line output must NOT include REVIEW_RESULT)
RED: fails until reviewer-base.md is updated in T3

### test_no_min_score_in_output_contract
Given: reviewer-base.md
When: grep for MIN_SCORE in the mandatory output contract section
Then: NOT present
RED: fails until T3

### test_three_line_output_contract
Given: reviewer-base.md
When: extract the mandatory output contract section
Then: the section specifies exactly REVIEWER_HASH, FINDING_COUNT, FILES (and nothing else in the contract header)
RED: fails until T3

### test_two_key_json_schema
Given: reviewer-base.md
When: search for the required top-level keys in the JSON schema section
Then: ONLY 'findings' and 'summary' are specified as required top-level keys (no 'scores' key)
RED: fails until T3

### .test-index RED markers required
Add entries:
- tests/docs/test-reviewer-base-file-constraint.sh [test_no_review_result_in_output_contract]
- tests/docs/test-reviewer-base-file-constraint.sh [test_no_min_score_in_output_contract]
- tests/docs/test-reviewer-base-file-constraint.sh [test_three_line_output_contract]
- tests/docs/test-reviewer-base-file-constraint.sh [test_two_key_json_schema]

Note: existing tests (test_file_field_constraint, test_review_workflow_file_overlap_recovery) MUST remain unchanged and still pass.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] test_no_review_result_in_output_contract exists in test-reviewer-base-file-constraint.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'test_no_review_result_in_output_contract' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/docs/test-reviewer-base-file-constraint.sh
- [ ] .test-index has RED markers for all 4 new tests
  Verify: grep -q 'test_no_review_result_in_output_contract' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] Existing tests still pass: bash tests/docs/test-reviewer-base-file-constraint.sh — 4 existing PASS (not 8)
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/docs/test-reviewer-base-file-constraint.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'PASSED: 4'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
